fields.Name: T088 - Entity Form Section Search Filter
fields.Description: Tests the form-level section search-filter feature (SearchFilter + VisibleSectionCount==0 empty state) — distinct from field-section navigation (T67, which is about jumping/scrolling to sections) and from grid quick-search.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Members' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box (type 'Members', click the exact match), click a member row, then click 'Open Full Record' to load the full form. In the form toolbar there is a 'Search sections...' input. Type a term that matches at least one section name (e.g. part of a visible section heading) and confirm the visible sections narrow to matches. Then type gibberish (e.g. 'zzzqqq') and confirm a 'No sections found' empty state with a 'Clear search' action appears. Success is the section list RESPONDING to the filter in both directions. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Typing a matching term in the 'Search sections...' box narrows the visible form sections to matches
Typing a non-matching term shows a 'No sections found' empty state (with a Clear search option)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
